description: This PHP source file defines the DropDownHelper class, which provides functionality for managing dropdown lists within the SuiteCRM application, including scanning for dropdown definitions, filtering, updating, and saving dropdown configurations.

classes.name: DropDownHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing dropdown lists in SuiteCRM, including scanning modules for dropdown definitions, filtering dropdown options, and saving dropdown configurations.

methods.name: getDropDownModules
methods.description: Scans the modules directory for modules that contain an 'EditView.php' file and scans those files for dropdown definitions.

methods.name: scanForDropDowns
methods.description: Reads a given file and uses regex to find app_list_strings array definitions, recording the dropdown names found for a specific module.

methods.name: filterDropDown
methods.description: Filters dropdown options based on certain criteria, such as filtering out hidden modules for pre-5.0 versions.

methods.name: saveDropDown
methods.description: Processes request parameters to update and save dropdown list configurations, modifying PHP files that store dropdown definitions.

methods.name: getPatternMatchGlobal
methods.description: Returns a regex pattern for matching global dropdown list definitions in PHP code.

methods.name: getPatternMatch
methods.description: Returns a regex pattern for matching specific app_list_strings dropdown list definitions in PHP code.
